method: UC1-UC3 facts are the story bible's own facts and needles (data/corpus/v2/story-bible.json, generatorRules.winnerMustContainAllNeedles).

Traps are passages that look like an answer but are not one (topic present but answer absent, a forecast for a measured value, the wrong date, the wrong entity). Conflicts are passages that state a different value for the same fact.
eval/questions/bank.ts verifies every needle against the live corpus by article id (scripted check); passage ids are resolved at load time, never trusted from this file.
No model was called to write or label the bank.
v2 additions authored by OpenAI Codex; same vendor as Luna, disclosed. Numeric labels verified against exact planted passages. No paraphrase padding.
